# MediaSurf Technologies — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org

# About
MediaSurf Technologies is an AI-first learning technology company based in Waterloo, Ontario, Canada.
We build AI-powered learning products and custom LMS platforms for corporate training and education.

# Products
- LearnCraft Authoring Suite: AI course generator (GPT-4o) + live block-based editor. Generates lessons, quizzes, flashcards, branching scenarios. Exports SCORM/xAPI. https://learncraft.mediasurf.ca
- CreatorLoom: AI video course generator & authoring studio. Generates scripts, voiceovers, visuals, and animations — no filming required. https://creatorloom.mediasurf.ca
- PowerPoint AI Tool: Upload any PPT and convert slides to structured lessons, modules, and quizzes. https://learncraft.mediasurf.ca
- PitStop: Mobile mechanic marketplace connecting customers with certified mobile technicians. https://pitstop.mediasurf.ca

# Services
- Custom LMS Development: SCORM/xAPI-compliant platforms with AI integration, analytics, and SSO. https://mediasurf.ca/services/custom-lms-development
- Employee Onboarding & Corporate Training: Role-based learning pathways, AI-generated content, measurable outcomes. https://mediasurf.ca/services/employee-onboarding
